entries.description: Midway fee on terminal fulfilled measured FWA spend, in basis points. Charged in ETH to the treasury recipient; the fee model has one leg.
Share of purchaser rewards sent to the treasury pot, in basis points.
Share of purchaser rewards sent to the Shared Upside pot, in basis points. The remainder after the treasury and Shared Upside shares goes to the application.
Unix timestamp when the first Shared Upside cycle begins. Draws stay off at launch; activity and the skim accrue into cycle 1 from this timestamp until the owner calls enableDraws.
Length of each Shared Upside cycle after draws are enabled, in seconds.
Share of a cycle's accumulated pot paid to the draw winner, in basis points.
Delay before a failed Shared Upside VRF request may be retried, in seconds.
Chainlink VRF gas lane key hash used for randomness requests.
Chainlink VRF subscription ID that funds randomness requests.
Number of block confirmations Chainlink VRF waits before fulfilling a request.
Gas limit supplied to the VRF fulfillment callback.
Whether VRF requests are paid in native ETH rather than LINK.
Minimum native ETH balance, in wei, the VRF subscription must hold before the keeper tops it up.
